title: Take The Merchandise Of The Lord's Praises
summary: Discipline is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Buy that object which will go along with you; take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord
lifeApplication: Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
